### DangerousCallRaw(nint, uint, PgMemoryContext, uint, params ReadOnlySpan&lt;PgDatum&gt;)

Calls a native PostgreSQL version-1 entry point and copies its raw result to a selected owner.

```csharp
public static PgDatum DangerousCallRaw(nint function, uint resultTypeOid, PgMemoryContext context, uint collationOid, params ReadOnlySpan<PgDatum> arguments)
```

Parameters:

`function` — [nint](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.intptr)

The valid native entry-point address.

`resultTypeOid` — [uint](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.uint32)

The actual PostgreSQL return type.

`context` — [PgMemoryContext](/api/ankus.pgmemorycontext/)

The returned datum's owner.

`collationOid` — [uint](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.uint32)

The input collation, or zero for none.

`arguments` — [ReadOnlySpan&lt;PgDatum&gt;](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.readonlyspan-1)

The exact raw arguments and SQL NULL flags.

Returns: [PgDatum](/api/ankus.pgdatum/)

A checked copy of the returned datum.

The caller owns ABI correctness and pointer validity. FmgrInfo, context, and resultinfo are null.
Pointer-bearing types such as internal retain their bits; copying them does not clone their pointees.

<a id="member-79c9cd0a88de213c"></a>

### DangerousCall&lt;T&gt;(nint, uint, params ReadOnlySpan&lt;PgDatum&gt;)

Calls a native PostgreSQL version-1 entry point and copies a supported managed result.

```csharp
public static T DangerousCall<T>(nint function, uint collationOid, params ReadOnlySpan<PgDatum> arguments)
```

Type parameters:

`T`

The entry point's actual result type.

Parameters:

`function` — [nint](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.intptr)

The valid native function address.

`collationOid` — [uint](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.uint32)

The input collation, or zero for none.

`arguments` — [ReadOnlySpan&lt;PgDatum&gt;](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.readonlyspan-1)

Live raw arguments matching the entry point's ABI and NULL contract.

Returns: <code>T</code>

The copied managed result, including SQL NULL for nullable types.

The caller must prove the address and argument/result representations are correct. The native
call has no FmgrInfo, context, or resultinfo; use catalog calls for functions needing those fields.
PostgreSQL errors remain guarded, but invalid pointers or ABI contracts can crash the backend.
